project: Heart Disease Risk Prediction - Basic/Enhanced two-tier architecture

split.note: Fresh split (seed=2026), distinct from the ML-3/4 split (seed=42). Test set touched exactly once, after all decisions were frozen using dev-only CV.

A_Basic.bmi_note: BMI computed from Height+Weight for display only - never a model feature or form field.
A_Basic.alternative_algorithm: RandomForest (n_estimators=400, max_depth=10, max_features='sqrt') - comparable performance, no statistically significant difference (paired t-test p=0.345 on dev CV)

threshold.rationale: Basic tier: forcing a 95%-sensitivity threshold costs specificity down to ~0.60 (many false positives) given the weaker Basic-only discrimination (AUC~0.94). The balanced Youden threshold (sens 0.85 / spec 0.88 on dev OOF) is used instead.

B_Enhanced.bmi_note: BMI computed from Height+Weight for display only - never a model feature or form field.
B_Enhanced.exclusion_reason: Confirmed via dev-only CV permutation importance and direct retrain comparison (ML-3/4, re-verified in the ML-final-audit): near-zero incremental value once Age/BP/lipids/RBS are present.
B_Enhanced.alternative_algorithm: RandomForest (n_estimators=400, max_depth=10, max_features='sqrt') - comparable performance, no statistically significant difference (paired t-test p=0.232 on dev CV)

threshold.rationale: Enhanced tier's stronger discrimination (AUC~0.98) supports a 95%-sensitivity operating point while retaining good specificity (~0.90 on dev OOF) - consistent with prioritizing sensitivity for a screening-support tool.

disclaimer: Research prototype. Not externally validated, not prospectively evaluated, not approved for clinical use.
limitations: Single-institution, retrospective, hospital-admitted cohort - not a population-screening sample (case-mix bias).
Label-construction question (how 'Heart Disease' was originally assigned) remains open and independently unverifiable.
Enhanced tier's strong performance leans partly on the same LDL/Total-Cholesterol/Triglycerides variables flagged as abnormally-correlated in the original audit.
Advanced/research feature set (Troponin-I, electrolytes, Haemoglobin, Creatinine, Platelets) was evaluated for research/sensitivity purposes only and is not part of this deployment architecture.
